name: cable-shrug.html
instructions:
1. Set 2 cable handles as low as possible and assume a standing position with one handle in each hand.
2. Inhale and contract the traps to elevate the shoulders. Squeeze hard at the top and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position.
3. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
